newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as shares in Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $12.625 from $12.50 while Audi held steady at $17.25.
Solidere A shares were unchanged from Friday's $10.5 and B shares rose to $11 from $10.875.
Turnover in Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to 15,000 shares from Friday's 10,500 while turnover in Audi fell to 10,850 from Friday's 17,231.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 77,094 shares for a value of $918,410.5 compared with Friday's 81,505 shares for $1,024,840.
The BLOM index was up 0.48 percent to 912.89 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.21 percent to 81.76.

"The LISPI moved up 0.21 percent to 81.76 as the price of Solidere B shares increased to $11 and BLC shares increased to $12.625. Solidere A and Audi shares were unchanged at $10.5 and $17.25 respectively," Lebanon Invest Research Company, which compiles the index, said in its daily bulletin.
